subject: Approval needed: senior infra — creative comp package for Sofia Morales
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: Senior Infra — request for creative comp approval (Sofia Morales)

Hi team,

We have a verbal yes from Sofia Morales (candidate for Senior Infrastructure Engineer) but she has a competing counteroffer that materially exceeds our band for the role. I am requesting an out-of-band package to close this hire — details below. Asking for review/approval by EOD Tuesday so we can send the formal letter.

Candidate summary:
- Sofia Morales, 10+ yrs infra/infra-security, ex-CloudScale SRE lead
- Strong ML infra + reliability background; will be IC4/Staff-equivalent

Proposed one-off package (ask):
- Base salary: $200,000 (top of band)
- Annual target bonus: 15%
- Sign-on: $40,000 (one-time, paid over 6 months)
- RSU: 40,000 RSUs (4-year vest; propose 15k as immediate refresh grant on top of band)
- Note: Candidate requests 6-month accelerated partial vesting for retention

Rationale:
- Market comp at CloudScale and others is ~25% above our typical band for this profile
- Risk of losing candidate; mission-critical for Q1 infra projects
- Budget owner (platform) confirmed discretionary headcount uplift if we keep TC within approved delta

Attachments: SofiaMorales_Offer_Summary.pdf (comp breakdown, benchmarking screenshots).

Ask:
1) Approve the out-of-band sign-on and RSU refresh as a one-off exception
2) Confirm any compliance/HR constraints we should apply (vesting amendment, clawback language)

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Hiring Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Senior Infra — request for creative comp approval (Sofia Morales)

Marissa — thanks for the context and the quick summary. A few clarifying Qs before I give an initial thumbs-up:

- Is the $40k sign-on cash or equity? You noted both in different threads; we should be explicit in offer language.
- Can platform absorb the base/bonus delta if we keep total expected spend under $265k TC first-year?
- On accelerated vesting: we generally avoid <12mo events, but will consider a 6-mo partial cliff on the refresh tranche only.

If the ask is strictly $40k cash + 15k RSU refresh (on top of band RSUs), I can provisionally approve subject to: 1) HR legal agrees to the amended vesting clause, 2) Finance signs off on cost source and headcount coding, and 3) we label this as a single hire exception in the comp system.

Please send the candidate benchmark (comps) and the handwritten notes from the hiring interview loop; I'll accelerate the review today.

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Director, People & Comp
Redwood Inference

On Tue, 15 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:

Karthik / Laura —

Attached are the benchmarking screenshots and the interview summary. Quick answers to your Qs:
- Sign-on: $40k cash (one-time)
- RSU refresh: 15,000 units on top of the role band grant (grant window: immediate)
- Platform confirmed funding; this will be coded to project INFRA-Q1 and counted against our discretionary hiring budget.

Why this matters: candidate has a competing counter that includes $30k sign-on + 20k RSUs. We are asking for a modest delta to be competitive and hedge hiring delay risk.

If we have agreement on the conditional approvals Karthik suggested, I will prepare the offer and loop in legal for the vesting amendment language. Candidate is asking for an offer by EOD Wednesday PST.

Thanks —
Marissa

-----Original Message-----
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Senior Infra — request for creative comp approval (Sofia Morales)

Folks —

HR & Legal comments:
- We can approve a one-time cash sign-on of up to $45k if Finance confirms budget coding; require a signed repayment/clawback schedule tied to resignation within 12 months.
- RSU refresh: we can issue an additional 15k in RSUs as a refresh grant; RSUs should vest on the standard 4-year schedule with a special 6-mo partial vest on 25% of the refresh tranche (i.e., 3,750 RSUs at 6 months). Remaining refresh tranche to vest over the standard schedule.
- Vesting amendment: Legal will prepare an addendum; HR needs final approved offer language before DocuSign.
- Headcount: this must be filled against existing approved headcount (INFRA-2026-HC-07). If headcount differs, we need People Ops sign-off.

Please confirm that Finance will accept INFRA-Q1 as the cost center and that we will log this exception in the comp system for audit.

-Laura

-----Original Message-----
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 11:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Senior Infra — request for creative comp approval (Sofia Morales)

Confirmed with Finance: INFRA-Q1 will cover the incremental first-year cash cost. We will code the sign-on and the first-year run rate to INFRA-Q1; ongoing equity run-rate will be accounted for in the FY27 comp plan. Please make sure Offer carries proper cost center string (INFRA-Q1 / RC-2026-1121). No additional headcount approval required — this is within our discretionary hiring envelope.

Jordan
Senior Finance Manager

-----Original Message-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Approval: Senior Infra — Sofia Morales (conditional)

Approvals: Granted (conditional).
1) $40,000 one-time cash sign-on — approved.
2) 15,000 RSU refresh — approved, with a 25% 6-month partial vest on the refresh tranche as Laura proposed.
3) Base at $200k / 15% target bonus — acceptable at top of band.

Conditions:
- Offer language must include the repayment/clawback schedule for the sign-on (Laura will provide boilerplate)
- Label this a one-off comp exception in the comp system with case ID RC-2026-1121
- Candidate must accept in writing by 2026-12-20 23:59 PST; this approval expires if not accepted by then.

Please proceed to finalize offer and send to candidate. Thanks for moving quickly on this.

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Director, People & Comp
Redwood Inference

On Fri, 19 Dec 2026 15:20:00 -0800, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:

Karthik / Laura / Jordan —

Offer sent to candidate (verbal acceptance earlier tonight). DocuSign envelope live: https://docusign.com/envelope/12345-abcde

Attachments: Offer_letter_v1.docx, Comp_approval_form.pdf

Next steps:
- Laura: please upload the signed addendum to the employee file when returned; coordinate payroll for sign-on split across 2 payments (30% at start / remaining 70% at 6 months as discussed).
- Jordan: confirm chargeback coding after the offer is fully executed.
- Karthik: I will mark the comp exception closed in the comp system once signed.

Thanks team — excited to have Sofia joining us.

-Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Hiring Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs]
- SofiaMorales_Offer_Summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
- Offer_letter_v1.docx (DOCX, 45KB)
- Comp_approval_form.pdf (PDF, 80KB)

[End of thread]
